We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied first two templates, got products (precursors). Need to continue applying remaining templates sequentially to each resulting precursor? Typically retrosynthesis route: start from target, apply template 29646 to get some intermediate(s). Then apply 1914389 to that intermediate, etc. We need to produce a JSON tree with reactions and molecules.

We have after first template 29646 applied to target gave three possible outcomes (list of three SMILES). The result from apply_template gave a tuple of three SMILES strings (maybe three possible precursors). We need to choose one path that can continue through the remaining templates.

The result: 
('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))

So three possible precursors. We used the first one for next template (1914389) and got result: two products: ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC')

So applying 1914389 gave two fragments (since it's a disconnection). Likely the first is the main fragment (still contains the core) and second is a side reagent (maybe a protecting group). For retrosynthesis we need to keep the fragment that leads to target; the other is a reagent that may be a building block.

We need to continue applying template 1914390 to the main fragment (first SMILES). Let's get template 1914390.
